spec.material: the lesson plan for one lesson: the objectives it teaches and the steps that teach them
spec.audience: the teacher who will teach this lesson to the class
structure: lesson objectives, each tied to one of the lesson's curriculum objectives
steps in teaching order: an introduction, the core steps, and an evaluation where the lesson has one
for each step: what the teacher does and what the students do, and for each student activity in a core step whether it sets them work of their own
entry behaviour, instructional materials and references
requirements: Teach the lesson's curriculum objectives and nothing outside them.
Give every core step the one lesson objective it teaches.
Say for every student activity in a core step whether it sets the students work of their own.
Fit the steps into the lesson's time.

parts.name: lesson_objectives
parts.description: The lesson objectives that teach this curriculum objective, in teaching order; an empty list when the lesson does not teach it. The lesson has 1 to 4 lesson objectives in all.

fields.name: objective
fields.description: The lesson objective: what the students will be able to do by the end of the lesson, in the teacher's own words where the source states it.

fields.name: kc_type
fields.description: What kind of knowledge the objective is: concept (a definition or idea), procedure (a step-by-step method) or representation (reading or drawing a form such as a diagram, number line or table).

fields.name: kc_focus
fields.description: The specific skill or idea the objective teaches. Objectives of one curriculum objective differ in it, or in their source and target forms.

fields.name: source_form
fields.description: For a representation: the form the students start from.

fields.name: target_form
fields.description: For a representation: the form they change it to.

fields.name: core_step
fields.description: The core step that teaches this objective: the teaching the source gives for it.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The step's title.

fields.name: content
fields.description: What the step covers, for the teacher.

fields.name: estimated_minutes
fields.description: How many minutes the step takes: 1 or more.

fields.name: activities
fields.description: What happens in the step, in order: who does it, and what.

fields.name: who
fields.description: Who does it.

fields.name: what
fields.description: What they do.

fields.name: sets_work
fields.description: For a student activity: true when it gives the students work of their own, false when they take part in the teaching. Leave it out for a teacher activity.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: What the step teaches, in order, starting with an explanation. A concept objective's step has no worked example; a procedure or representation objective's step has a worked example and practice.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The explanation, as the teacher gives it.

kinds.name: worked_example
kinds.description: A problem solved step by step.

fields.name: problem
fields.description: The problem.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: The working, one step at a time.

fields.name: label
fields.description: What the step does.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The working of the step.

fields.name: final_answer
fields.description: The answer.

fields.name: question
fields.description: The question.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The answer expected.

fields.name: hints
fields.description: Hints, in the order to give them.

fields.name: check_questions
fields.description: Questions in the evaluation that check this objective: one or more.

fields.name: question
fields.description: The question.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The answer expected.

fields.name: hints
fields.description: Hints, in the order to give them.

lesson_parts.name: theme
lesson_parts.description: The lesson's theme, when the curriculum or the document names one.

lesson_parts.name: entry_behaviour
lesson_parts.description: What the students already know or can do from earlier lessons.

lesson_parts.name: instructional_materials
lesson_parts.description: What the teacher uses in the lesson.

lesson_parts.name: misconceptions
lesson_parts.description: Mistakes students are likely to make in this lesson, for the teacher to address.

lesson_parts.name: references
lesson_parts.description: The textbooks and sources the lesson draws on.

lesson_parts.name: assessments
lesson_parts.description: Assessment questions set for after the lesson, aligned to its lesson objectives.

fields.name: question
fields.description: The question.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The answer expected.

fields.name: rubric
fields.description: How an answer is marked.

lesson_parts.name: intro
lesson_parts.description: The introduction: how the lesson opens, recalling what the students already know and framing the lesson, in a few minutes. It teaches no lesson objective; each objective is taught in its own core step.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The step's title.

fields.name: content

fields.name: estimated_minutes
fields.description: How many minutes the step takes.

fields.name: activities

fields.name: sets_work
fields.description: For a student activity: true when it gives the students work of their own, false when they take part in the teaching. Leave it out for a teacher activity.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: What the introduction explains, if anything.

fields.name: content
fields.description: The explanation, as the teacher gives it.

lesson_parts.name: evaluation
lesson_parts.description: The evaluation that ends the lesson: its title, summary, minutes and activities. Its questions are the check questions written with each lesson objective.
